notes.title: AoT 1 + 3 Redo Update
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017070/edb082c327a93622eac8d44ce5ea68cb37c53e71.jpg[/img]

[b]Army of Tentacles 1[/b]'s redo is about 50% complete. All of the side quests are finished. Brain fog is not helping my productivity, but I'm doing about two quests a day, plus a quest a day on [b]Army of Tentacles 2[/b]. 

I know I originally set the release date for February, and then March, but if they both are ready by the end of January, they might be both launching then.

Don't worry. I fully realize my workload as well as my current state of being/mind/health, so it might not happen.

[b]Army of Tentacles 3[/b] is a different story. It's a lot less restrictive than Army 1, both code-wise and VO-wise (because there is no VO). We thought about adding VO to the game, but ruled against it, as that would be money we need for [b]Unicorns[/b] and [b]Dinosaur Cousin Squad[/b], and the game's plot relied on a lack of VO. 

The biggest change to Army 3 is that we are cutting down the number of Arguments for a leaner, faster experience. With the DLCs, Army 3 has a whopping 70 Arguments to Army 1's, what, 20? I don't yet know how that is going to translate into quests yet. Some quests might be merged with others, I don't know yet. A lot of the Arguments were not even related to quests, and those may be the majority that go. Another feature that is going to take some busywork.... Army 3 has a large party, and it'll be interesting to see what skills change, what stay the same, and what have fun new uses.

notes.title: Steam Winter Sale 2022! (+ Winter Updates)
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017070/83e104259b3e54fb1c3293428e4574917d14fdef.png[/img]
[h1]Winter Sale[/h1]
No one could have predicted this.

Oh, and Dino Sim 2022 is droppig next week. Could be Monday, could be Friday. Or Tuesday. Or the other two. Just in time to miss Christmas as well as Christmas Eve. Blame the Gregorian Calendar and the constant shift of yearly dates for that chestnut.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2153400/Scientifically_Accurate_Dinosaur_Mating_Simulator_2022_American_Revolution_1775__1786
Oh, and a 2023 treat....

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017070/121baf221805377562db7466bf68353786e9ab3e.jpg[/img]
[h1]Army 1 and 3: The Actual Recode(s)[/h1]
So, later on in 2023, the oft prophecized recode is happening..... the code for both Army 1 and Army 3 broke. The Steam versions still work. So that's the good news. If you buy it this sale, you will be buying a working game. It's just the versions on our end that need to be fixed. Which ultimately means that there will be a patch to both games later on down the line.

I want to make it clear that [b]both games work perfectly fine[/b] on Steam. If you were planning on making any purchases of the game or DLC this Winter Sale, feel free to do so.

When the newest update to the engine that we use hit, it scrambled our 2016 Code bases brain. Without going into lengthy explanations, the base code for Army 1 (Utahraptor) was written in such a way that, if you push one domino, the whole thing is gonna crumble. We were young and inexperienced. Shit happens.

While Army 3 came out pretty unscathed, it still uses the Argument/Word Battle code. So we need to redo it as well.

The good news is that both games will have fresher, better code. We will be keeping as much as the base game intact as we can. We're also going to try our best to keep the file size to the same as what it was, even though we'll be adding a few new baubles. They will include:
[list]
[*] [b]Updated Word Battles[/b]: Stats and abilities will now have a bigger impact on how they play out.
[*] [b]New Army Units and Art[/b]: We'll have actual art for the Army units.
[*] [b]New Level Up/Upgrade screens[/b]: For a better, clearer idea of how you're going to shape your army of monsters for the new endgame Invasion.
[*] [b]Updated [/b] Shops and Stats
[*] [b]Redone[/b] endgame Invasion system
[*] [b]Redone[/b] DLC pathcode
[*] [b]New[/b] UI
[/list]
Those patches will hit sometime (hopefully) early this year, with Army of Tentacles 1's patch going up before Army 3. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017070/1cc95eb9870f83b93d977de5657b32941404430b.png[/img]
[h1]Introducing: DINOSAUR COUSIN SQUAD![/h1]
Our first platformer  - made in GameMaker Studio 2. While we were going to shift the release dates for our current 2023 crop to get this out before Summer Sale, the version of base code that we got earlier last month still needed a fair amount of polish, and we didn't want to have our contractors work through the holidays. Our current investors were cool with the shift, but since it's going to need more time to cook before we can really start work on it, we're going to try to clear our slate of current investor projects before working on this one in full. 

Earlier in October, we had split up into two teams: Team Army of Tentacles - working on Army 2, Tentacle Prawn, and Unicorn Island - and Team Cousin Squad - working on Dinosaur Cousin Squad only. But because Dinosaur Cousin Squad has shifted, Team DCS has now taken up a new project that will also be officially announced next month:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017070/5296b50d44424d80c3a3908b376abb9eb54ff686.jpg[/img]
[h1]To Date Or Not To Date Cat Girls? 2 is in development[/h1]
While [b]Tentacle Prawn[/b] is the game where we detail the relationship between our Lovecraft and Shakespeare worlds, [b]Furry Shakespeare: To Date Or Not To Date Cat Girls?[/b] 2 is going to be a more standalone title that deals specifically with the various Furry Shakespeare tales we've been telling so far. For instance, we have an entire group that actually deals with keeping the spirit of the holidays alive. How do they fit into the overall lore? Do they also go to the same college for royalty that everyone else does? What about the Spooky Scary Halloween Spooky Times and Historylands crews? Those are retail jobs. Why do those exist in this world? 

But the most important question of all: can you date a Monarch Butterfly? 

Originally, [b]Spooky Cat Girls?[/b] was going to be the canon sequel to [b]Cat Girls?[/b], but.... well, not anymore, obviously.

Happy holidays.

Dunno if this announcement is really warranted. Just want to let people know what is going on. 

[b]Super Army of Tentacles: (Not) A Cthulhu Dating Sim[/b] has three main mechanics: skills/attributes, Word Battles, and Armies.

Well, it did. See, I started work on the project when things were.... let's say, different in the USA, and that, in turn, fueled the direction of the thing. We had already wanted to do something new with AoT 1's army mechanic, but do it better than the first game. Do it with all the game dev we had learned over the years since we've started. So I felt that my internal anger was a good fuel for said mechanic. Who doesn't love a good 'throw out the bad guys' story?

While the main story of the game is still 'the humans somehow occupied Monster Land', after recent events, I just don't feel good about a mechanic where you pre-meditatively build up militias to take over areas. We talked about this, and the bottom line is that we feel that even though the Army mechanic would have been solid, it would have taken away from the main gameplay loop of the first two games. Even though there was a final Invasion mechanic in the first game, the way you recruited your army was never the focal point. The focals were the Word Battles. 

At the end of the day, real people make games, and we don't want to be making a game that we feel isn't up to snuff or is pushed in two different directions. This is the last in the trilogy for us. We know more now and want to do it right, as both a stand alone title and a series cap.

This also allows us to put greater focus on the idea of reactivity to your choices in the world's hubs. Which is cool. 

I'm writing this because, even though it wasn't the selling point of the game or even showcased in screenshots or the trailer, it was in the initial store description and there were shots of it in the trailer and on the screenshot gallery. We've already updated the gallery, but will also be updating the trailer shortly. 

This really doesn't affect the already delayed release date of 2022. If anything, it clarifies a release date. If anything, at max what it means is this will release post-summer 2022, but I honestly don't think that's a concern.

notes.content:
Okay, so here's the deal:

The Army of Tentacles 1 remaster is hitting some snags. The easiest to work on right now is that it is getting way too big file size-wise - bigger than the original size by far. So I don't think it is fair to drastically change the file size for an existing userbase. Which leaves the project with three options:

1) [b]Release it as a separate, free DLC instead of a free patch[/b]
But, if we're going to do this, we would have to throw in the new backgrounds as well (since there's absolutely no point in having DLC for DLC), and by then, we'd basically be selling the same game as a paid DLC. Which, while it is not unprecedented for a DLC to overhaul a base game's mechanics, it wouldn't serve the original purpose of the remasters, which was for every pre-exisiting and future user to have a retooled game.

2) [b]Only upgrade the resolution[/b]
This way, we'd still be able to sell the new backgrounds as an "HD 4K OMG LOLLERS" DLC for those that want a bit more of the game's backgrounds but still like the base game.

But that would potentially still increase the base game file size for existing users.

3) [b]Make a new Army of Tentacles game entirely, scrap the upgrade patches altogether[/b]
Obviously, if this happened, it would probably be the same price as the original game ($4.99) and use the art from either AoT 3 or [OTHER SECRET IN-UNIVERSE PROJECTS].

notes.title: Argument System 3.0 and YOU!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11959844/47d2f23f1005f186cd14ce7beb36b3b1e57e04ef.jpg[/img]

We at the office have been working on the new foundation code for [b]Super Army of Tentacles: (Not) A Cthulhu Dating Sim[/b], and are so happy with its progress that we have decided to tear out the combat system for [b]Paper Shakespeare RPG[/b] and replace it with the new update to the Army of Tentacles series' Argument System. Honestly? It works better with the theme of the game, and means that we can get it out sooner.

We are still hard at work on a combat system for a later RPG. 

[h1]What will be included in the new system?[/h1]
A much more code-friendly system means that stats will greatly affect the word battles, as well as giving us the the opportunity to make much cooler skills that affect the battles in much deeper ways. 

[h1]Will you be putting Argument System 3.0 in the previous two Army of Tentacles games? Say, before the new Army of Tentacles comes out?[/h1]
I would love to say yes. Let's get into why it might not happen, or might take a while to happen.

Because of the way the original Utahraptor framework (the thing that holds all our systems together in RenPy) was written, it would require a complete code overhaul, and that means an overhaul of two separate games. In that case, we're basically redoing [b]Army of Tentacles: (Not) A Cthulhu Dating Sim[/b] and [b]Super Army of Tentacles 3: The Search for Army of Tentacles 2[/b] from the ground up. 

Even with an existing script to work off of, we're also talking all of the DLC, the works. Everything would be redone. Every scene, every quest, every Argument, every mechanic. Then we'd need to actually take the copy-pasted Argument System 3.0 and make sure it would have the things required for that specific game. 

We're also talking about doing this at no cost to the user, just a simple, free patch. Sadly, we have to weigh that in as a factor, as we do have other games on the slate. We're talking about a 2016 game and a 2017 game, after all. Would we improve the art and resolution for Army 1, to put it in line with the other two games in the trilogy? Would we do art but just leave the resolution the same? 

Is it unfair to any new or existing players to leave Army 1 and Army 3 as is if the new one is going to be, for lack of any other term, badass?

[h1]The Summary[/h1]
[b]Paper Shakespeare RPG[/b] is getting a cooler combat system. Dunno yet if the previous [b]Army of Tentacles[/b] game will get a facelift.

We're very excited to show you the next step.

notes.content:

[b]A note on packs:[/b] Each game that gets some sort of Ultimate Edition later on down the line will have that version replace the base version (along with all DLC for that game) in the bundle.

notes.title: Year Update: some medical chicanery.
notes.content:
Bryy here (I mean, it's always safe to assume that I'm the one writing these things because, 90% of the time, I am). Update on the rest of the year.

Earlier this morning, I ran into some medical issues - some old war wounds that decided they would like to wish me a late happy birthday. Nothing major, and even the definition of the surgery I need is minor. Which is a let-down, as I totally would have been cool with looking up the classification and finding that it just passes for MAJOR SURGERY. 

However, having had this surgery at least once in my lifetime, I can tell you that the recovery process is rather long and hard on the body. 

But on to the meat.
What does this mean for the rest of the year?
[list]
    [*][b]CHARITY DLC #3: DESERT BUS[/b]: Moved from this week to most likely next week due to doctor visits.
    [*][b]SPOOPY! SALE[/b]: Expect it to be moved to late this month and downsized to Army 3 only. There will still be an Army 1 sale in mid-October.
    [*][b]HALLOWEEN QUEST AND OUTFIT PACK[/b]: Still on track for October 13th.
    [*][b]NEW GAME+ BENEFITS 2 EXPANSION PACK[/b]: Depends on recovery. If the surgery is in November, expect NG+B2 in January. If December, expect February.
    [*][b]The Ghost of Joe Papp[/b]: Same as NG+B2. Depends on recovery. If the surgery is in November, expect Joe Papp in January. If December, expect February.
[/list]

notes.title: GAME #3 and 2017 TIMELINE
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28698999/2471246cb94e5fce3d74c50c0accfd46f91609d3.jpg[/img]

We're just now starting work on our third game (and second IP), [b]The Ghost of Joe Papp[/b].

While we can't really reveal anything about it at this point, we can say that it is going to be far less intense than either Army games were. It's just going to be different, which we feel is good. Not every single one of our games should feel the same in style nor should they be the same in execution.

It will be $4.99 - $8.99 range.

The next you hear about Joe Papp will most likely be when we put the Coming Soon page up on Steam in late October/early November.

notes.title: Discount mix-up: Birthday Sale Update
notes.content:
Well, so we got to the bottom of what happened to mix up the discount sale, and we're happy to announce that the Birthday Sale is still on.

A few compromises.

It is no longer a weekend-long flash sale of super low prices on all Army 1 items, but instead a regular two week discount sale of regular mark downs. 

Why? Two reasons: the first being that if we did a flash sale, it would knock all Army 1 items out of the running for the SPOOPY/Twitch Con sale in October; the second being that we still really wanted to do a sale that was around the time of significance for our team - namely birthdays. So we picked a date that would satisy both of these requirements. 

The Birthday Sale will run August 7th - 20th.

notes.title: SUPER ARMY OF TENTACLES 3 UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11959844/e31c672b47457c0e0f195cee497815aa89bf7035.jpg[/img]

So we're pretty much THIS CLOSE to putting up a Coming Soon page. We just need to make a trailer. So expect a formal Steam page in maybe a few weeks.

What's we're focused on now is making sure all of the bugs are gone, as well as various stat buffs and debuffs here and there in the script. The shop system right now is a little ridiculous when it comes to prices.

The new RNG system for enemy spawns needs polish, the Argument System works but we need to test all the party abilities (of which we have some really cool ones that we can't wait to have you find and play with). 

AoT 1 had 4 RNG enemies and 12 RNG fights total. AoT 3 has 26 and 34 fights total. AoT 1's boss count was around 18, AoT 3's is 43 (the vast majority of those being side quests).

Also, it increases our current word count of 95k to 100k. So. You know. Ego strokes all around.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11959844/6c21fc26cd46f1faee7e7f76c8d9645f0df2d7ef.jpg[/img]

Unfortunately, this means yet another delay. But this is only by a few days.

JUNE 1st.

See you then.

notes.title: SUPER ARMY 3 update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11959844/12c7f1254b25ab297747024570d58130e9019ff4.jpg[/img]

Good news, everyone! We've been approved for Steam release! We're halfway done with the code, and the BETA is currently being played by a small group of awesome people! 

This morning, we just recieved the last background art for the Boston hub, so now we have the full art for one entire hub done. Speaking of hubs, since the last update, we've had to cut down the size of the world map in order to beef up the various hub locations.

The Middle East and most of Europe are gone, with their respective scenes going to the East and West Coast, respectively. While we wanted a globe-trotting adventure, we felt that, ultimately, we needed to focus less on size and more on scope. 

Argument System 2.0 should be up by this weekend, but will not be input into the code until next month. We're focusing 100% on finishing the main paths before we begin on that.

Our roadmap right now looks like this:

* FEBRUARY: Finish the main path of the game, playtesting various areas while we go.

* EARLY MARCH: Set up the Argument and Party Systems. Depending on how this goes, it might push our schedule back a bit. Playtesting.

* MID MARCH: Start creating the Arguments, of which we aim for around fifty for variety sake. We don't want people running into the same RNG Argument over and over. Playtesting.

* LATE MARCH: NPCs & Side Quests. While at least 90% of all dialogue NPCs are in-game and we have our dialogue and quest systems set up as well as a Quest Book, we are not focused on side quests or misc. dialogue at this point. Playtesting. 

* EARLY APRIL: Make sure everything is polished. Put up the Steam page.

* APRIL 24th - MAY 19th: Release window.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11959844/3e8ec1d11d95a9e3331290411fc7d3bd50d73612.jpg[/img]

notes.title: SUPER ARMY 3 update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11959844/12c7f1254b25ab297747024570d58130e9019ff4.jpg[/img]

Good news, everyone! We've been approved for Steam release! We're halfway done with the code, and the BETA is currently being played by a small group of awesome people! 

This morning, we just recieved the last background art for the Boston hub, so now we have the full art for one entire hub done. Speaking of hubs, since the last update, we've had to cut down the size of the world map in order to beef up the various hub locations.

The Middle East and most of Europe are gone, with their respective scenes going to the East and West Coast, respectively. While we wanted a globe-trotting adventure, we felt that, ultimately, we needed to focus less on size and more on scope. 

Argument System 2.0 should be up by this weekend, but will not be input into the code until next month. We're focusing 100% on finishing the main paths before we begin on that.

Our roadmap right now looks like this:

* FEBRUARY: Finish the main path of the game, playtesting various areas while we go.

* EARLY MARCH: Set up the Argument and Party Systems. Depending on how this goes, it might push our schedule back a bit. Playtesting.

* MID MARCH: Start creating the Arguments, of which we aim for around fifty for variety sake. We don't want people running into the same RNG Argument over and over. Playtesting.

* LATE MARCH: NPCs & Side Quests. While at least 90% of all dialogue NPCs are in-game and we have our dialogue and quest systems set up as well as a Quest Book, we are not focused on side quests or misc. dialogue at this point. Playtesting. 

* EARLY APRIL: Make sure everything is polished. Put up the Steam page.

The main page for Super Army 3 is [url=http://www.stegalosaurus.org/copy-of-army-of-tentacles-hub]here[/url].

Paper Shakespeare: It's Not Hamlet (Again)! is now on Steam Greenlight!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11959844/bdcedf2789892d4f6322478698a224bce95ecbfb.jpg[/img]

We are very proud to be able to announce our second game!

WELCOME TO ELSINORE ACADEMY! 
The most prestigious school for future Kings, Queens, Dictators, and Popes that Denmark has to offer! It has a Glee Club, a D&D club, and the cheerleaders are literally witches! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11959844/1759c47beb25cc441698ad403a7d764145169bfb.jpg[/img]
Guide Hamlet through the classic story of Hamlet, where - wait, why is there a SECOND Hamlet? Why is this second Hamlet a girl? And a werewolf? What is going on here? 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11959844/ca28bdf7243ace133bbc57693cf1910f6c2e3152.jpg[/img]
Go through five acts of coming-of-age zaniness, murder, and slash-fic. Or don't. It is entirely up to you. Hamlet's journey could go the traditional route, or you could end up.... commanding a Not U.S.S. Enterprise? 

You like Shakespeare Adaptations? Good. 'CAUSE THIS IS ALL OF THEM. 

Features: 
* point based Emotional Attributes that affect the different routes of the story 
* a unique art style reflecting the various.... oddities..... that are befalling This Elsinore. This? Are there More Elsinores? 
* 14 endings all with various non-ending specific branches (meaning 14 unique endings that can also be affected by the routes you chose) 

MATURE for MATURE LANGUAGE and SEXY TIME DISCUSSIONS. 

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

PS:IH(A)! came out of a programming prototype/class straight out of Steg Game Dev's time showing off Army of Tentacles at Comic-Con 2016. As we moved forward with it, we realized that it had the potential to be its own game that could be enjoyed by others. Thus, the current game you see before you on your computer screen was born.
